INVALID_MESSAGE: Envelope or type-specific payload violates the schema.
INVALID_TIME_RANGE: expiresAt or a slot/window end must be after its start.
UNKNOWN_AGENT: Agent is outside the fixed M1 allowlist.
DUPLICATE_AGENT: Only one active connection per agent ID is allowed.
SENDER_MISMATCH: Envelope sender must match the connection ID.
RECIPIENT_OFFLINE: M1 relay has no durable mailbox; sender retains the outbox.
MESSAGE_ID_CONFLICT: A logical message ID was reused with different content.
MESSAGE_EXPIRED: An expired new message cannot start domain work.
INVALID_ACK: ACK sender, meeting, scope, or referenced message is incorrect.
DELIVERY_UNCONFIRMED: Recipient persistence was not acknowledged within the retry budget.
STATE_IN_USE: Another live process owns this agent state directory.
STATE_OWNER_MISMATCH: A state directory belongs to another agent.
